name: Merina Kingdom (Madagascar)
description: A white field bearing the red initials 'R M' beneath a crowned emblem, with a red panel at the lower fly.
history: Royal flag of the Merina Kingdom of Madagascar under Queen Ranavalona, in white and red, the royal colours; the kingdom fell to France in 1897.

features.role: crowned cipher R M — Ranavalona Manjaka
